name: Growler's Grotto
description: Irish artist Dee Mulrooney presents Growler's Grotto, a shamanic performance centering a fictitious 78-year-old vulva from inner-city Dublin. Growler is an activist, abuse survivor, and feminist. The piece weaves together songs, spoken word and ceremony as part theatre, part portal, reclaiming the divine feminine and reframing Ireland's religious doctrine. Collaboration with Lunatraktors/Hazard Bears.
